detail.overview: The SA70BGHG 7 KG Semi-Automatic Washing Machine delivers high-performance cleaning with smart features designed for efficiency. Its rust-free body ensures durability, while the 3-fins pulsator and Collar Scrubber Technology remove stubborn stains effortlessly. A powerful motor provides superior washing, and noise-free spinning guarantees fast drying. The toughened glass lid adds a premium touch, and the water level indicator optimizes water usage. Built for smart and powerful washing, this machine is a must-have for modern homes.
